### Properties

#### BypassCustomLogic

```text
PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.CustomLogicBypass BypassCustomLogic { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets which custom business logic to bypass during execution.


Remarks: Requires the prvBypassCustomBusinessLogic privilege. By default, only System Administrators have this privilege. This bypasses custom plugins and workflows only. Microsoft&#x27;s core system plugins and solution workflows are NOT bypassed. Does not affect Power Automate flows - use P:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationOptions.BypassPowerAutomateFlows for that.

#### BypassPowerAutomateFlows

```text
System.Boolean BypassPowerAutomateFlows { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to bypass Power Automate flows. When true, flows using &quot;When a row is added, modified or deleted&quot; triggers will not execute. No special privilege is required. Default: false


#### ContinueOnError

```text
System.Boolean ContinueOnError { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to continue after individual record failures. Only applies to Delete operations on standard tables (ElasticTable = false). Elastic tables always support partial success automatically. Default: true


#### ElasticTable

```text
System.Boolean ElasticTable { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether the target is an elastic table (Cosmos DB-backed). When false (default, for standard SQL-backed tables): Create/Update/Upsert: Uses all-or-nothing batch semantics (any error fails entire batch) Delete: Uses ExecuteMultiple with individual DeleteRequests When true (for elastic tables): All operations support partial success with per-record error details Delete uses native DeleteMultiple API Consider reducing BatchSize to 100 for optimal performance Default: false


#### SuppressDuplicateDetection

```text
System.Boolean SuppressDuplicateDetection { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a value indicating whether to suppress duplicate detection. Default: false


#### BatchSize

```text
System.Int32 BatchSize { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the number of records per batch. Must be between F:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationOptions.MinBatchSize and F:PPDS.Dataverse.BulkOperations.BulkOperationOptions.MaxBatchSize inclusive. Benchmarks show 100 is optimal for both standard and elastic tables. Default: 100


#### MaxParallelBatches

```text
System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> MaxParallelBatches { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets the maximum number of batches to process in parallel. When null (default), uses the ServiceClient&#x27;s RecommendedDegreesOfParallelism which comes from the x-ms-dop-hint response header from Dataverse. Set to 1 for sequential processing, or a specific value to override Microsoft&#x27;s recommendation. Default: null (use RecommendedDegreesOfParallelism)


#### Tag

```text
System.String Tag { get; set; }
```

Gets or sets a tag value passed to plugin execution context.


Remarks: Plugins can access this value via context.SharedVariables[&quot;tag&quot;]. Useful for: Identifying records created by bulk operations in plugin logic Audit trails (e.g., &quot;Migration-2025-Q4&quot;, &quot;ETL-Job-123&quot;) Conditional plugin behavior based on data source No special privileges required.

### Fields

#### MaxBatchSize

```text
System.Int32 MaxBatchSize = 1000
```

Maximum allowed batch size (inclusive). Dataverse rejects values greater than 1000 with an opaque error that can make the whole batch fail silently, so we validate up-front.


#### MinBatchSize

```text
System.Int32 MinBatchSize = 1
```

Minimum allowed batch size (inclusive).
